attributes.name: auto
attributes.description: Render the whole panel from <meta> tags in <head> (meta-tag contract v1): author, link[rel=author] / article:author, last-modified / article:modified_time, article:published_time, itemprop=version, vb:version-url, vb:provenance, vb:ai-tools, vb:review, vb:status, license + link[rel=license], keywords, repeated meta[name=concept]. Values are inserted as text; links are used only when they resolve to http(s).

attributes.name: data-concept-base
attributes.description: Auto mode: base path for concept links ({base}{id}/). Must be relative or http(s); otherwise concepts render as plain text.

attributes.name: data-heading-level
attributes.description: Auto mode: heading level of the panel section headings.

attributes.name: data-label-reading-time
attributes.description: Template for [data-reading-time]; {n} is the Intl-formatted minute value ("5 min").

attributes.name: data-label-provenance
attributes.description: Auto mode UI string (default "How this was made").

attributes.name: data-label-ai-tools
attributes.description: Auto mode UI string (default "AI tools used").

attributes.name: data-label-tier-declared
attributes.description: Visible trust-tier text appended to the badge for data-trust="declared" (default "Self-declared").

attributes.name: data-label-tier-verified
attributes.description: Visible trust-tier text appended to the badge for data-trust="verified" (default "Verified").

attributes.name: data-label-tier-failed
attributes.description: Visible trust-tier text appended to the badge for data-trust="failed" (default "Signature failed").

attributes.name: data-label-tier-key-unavailable
attributes.description: Visible trust-tier text appended to the badge for data-trust="key-unavailable" (default "Key unavailable").

events.name: page-info:verified
events.description: Bubbles. Fired on every setup with the declared tier (undeclared/declared, no reason), then again with the verification result when the page carries meta[name=vb:signature]. reason: 'ok', 'mismatch', 'missing-author-key', 'unsupported-algorithm:…', 'canonicalize:…', 'verify:…', or the key fetch error.

childAttributes.name: data-trust
childAttributes.description: Verification tier, written by the component (the first .page-info-badge without data-status). A .page-info-tier span with the tier text is appended inside the badge.

childAttributes.name: data-provenance
childAttributes.description: vb:provenance token(s) the badge describes (styling hook).

childAttributes.name: data-status
childAttributes.description: Publication-status badge (auto mode renders it for non-published pages); excluded from trust updates.

childAttributes.name: data-relative
childAttributes.description: Rewrite the text as a localized relative time (Intl.RelativeTimeFormat, closest [lang]) from the datetime attribute; the absolute date is put in title unless the author set one. Future dates read "in 3 days".

childAttributes.name: datetime
childAttributes.description: ISO date or datetime read by time[data-relative]. Date-only values are formatted in UTC.

childAttributes.name: data-reading-time
childAttributes.description: Filled with the estimated reading time of the page's outermost [data-signable] roots (238 wpm / 500 CJK chars per minute, shared with page-stats; skips [data-signable=false], hidden and script content).

structure.description: Static mode: <details> with a <summary> trust bar (author as plain text, time[data-relative], .page-info-badge) and a .page-info-panel of sections. Keep links out of <summary>.
